title: 第3章 凌浩的霸道第4章 强大的凌家
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 宫殿内
乐曲响起，整座宫殿充满了乐器鸣雀般的欢声，宫殿内中心舞姬纷纷起舞，雪白的手袖起伏且丝滑
宫殿内里所有的人都享受这美味佳肴，把酒言欢，好不快活
“不知，凌族神子什么时候到呢”
这时青霜看着最高处的凌震天轻声道
“哈哈哈青霜宫主何必着急呢，一炷香想必就到了吧”
凌震天放下手中的酒杯笑着道，并看向宫殿外
“如此，到是我唐突了”
青霜歉声道便拿起桌面的葡萄轻轻的放进嘴巴
“哈哈哈，无妨”
凌震天笑着道
“如此高兴的日子，吾等何必在意那些小事呢”
“神子到”
这时宫殿外传来一道声
一个长相清秀，身着华丽，身上散发着高傲的气质，脸上却有着娇嫩的纯真，但他的眼中如同宇宙深渊，深不可测，如同混沌一般，整个人如同摘仙一般出现在世人的眼前
“这就是凌族的神子吗？”
感受到凌浩的气场，宫殿内的青霄仙宫的人都被深深的震撼到了，已经无法用语言来形容眼前的公子，哪怕整个三千大世界的天骄与之相比都黯然失色吧
“是啊，想不到凌神子才如此年纪就有如此修为，恐怕整个诸天都找不出第二人吧，果真是少年至尊啊”
“少年至尊？恐怕对于凌神子都是一种侮辱吧，少年仙帝才足以形容凌神子吧”
宫殿内赞声连篇四起，所有人都在讨论着凌浩
就连青霜宫主都感叹到摇头，以及旁边的彩儿更是如此
如此小的年纪，就有如此摘仙般的气质，修为更是深不可测
“根本比不上啊，亏我还自称三千大世界最年轻的天骄，与之相比，无疑就是蚂蚁与天斗，根本斗不过”
彩儿心中自叹道
“这臭小子是我儿子？”
凌震天看着走进宫殿的凌浩暗道，前阵子见面的时候好像不是这个样子吧，这才半月不见，怎么感觉换了个人似的
“见过父亲”
凌浩走到宫殿中心处，根本就不看在旁边的青霄仙宫的人，弯身恭敬道
凌浩他面色平静，看不出一丝神态，就连说的话更是平静的可怕
“此子不一般啊，百人面前如同入无人之地，生性更是平静，看不出任何波澜”
一旁的青霜看着凌浩暗道，对凌浩更是惊叹万分
“此次联姻势必拿下，不然我青霄仙宫怕是要没机会了”
随后
“好好好，浩儿先回座位吧，后面我们再讨论正事”
凌震天笑着看着凌浩满意的道，心里对这个儿子更加骄傲与自豪
“是，父亲”
说完，凌浩就回到自己专属的位置上，根本就没看青霄仙宫一眼，仿佛根本不存在一般
“师尊，我怎么感觉凌神子，根本不待见我们青霄仙宫啊”
彩儿心中传音给青霜说道，从凌浩如宫殿到现在，根本就没有正眼看过青霄仙宫
content_en:
inside the palace
The music sounded, and the whole palace was filled with the joyful sound of singing birds. The dancers in the center of the palace danced one after another, with their snow-white sleeves undulating and silky.
Everyone in the palace enjoyed the delicious food, drank wine and talked happily.
"I don't know when the Ling clan's divine son will arrive."
At this time, Qingshuang looked at Ling Zhentian at the top and said softly
"Hahaha, Master Qingshuang Palace, why should you be anxious? I'll be here in just one stick of incense."
Ling Zhentian put down the wine glass in his hand and said with a smile, and looked outside the palace.
"So, I'm being abrupt."
Qingshuang apologized and picked up the grapes on the table and gently put them into her mouth.
"Hahaha, no problem"
Ling Zhentian smiled and said
"On such a happy day, why should we care about the little things?"
...
"The Son of God has arrived"
At this time, a voice came from outside the palace
A man with a handsome appearance, gorgeous clothes, exuding a proud temperament, but a delicate innocence on his face, but his eyes are like the abyss of the universe, unfathomable, like chaos, and the whole person appears in front of the world like picking an immortal.
"Is this the divine son of the Ling clan?"
Feeling Ling Hao's aura, everyone in the Qingxiao Immortal Palace in the palace was deeply shocked. They could no longer describe the young master in front of them in words. Even the geniuses in the entire three thousand worlds would pale in comparison.
"Yeah, I didn't expect Ling Shenzi to have such cultivation at such a young age. I'm afraid I won't be able to find another person in the whole world. He is really the young supreme."
"Young Supreme? I'm afraid it's an insult to Ling Shenzi. Young Immortal Emperor is enough to describe Ling Shenzi."
There were compliments in the palace, and everyone was discussing Ling Hao
Even the master of Qingshuang Palace sighed and shook his head, and Cai'er next to him even more so.
At such a young age, he has such an immortal temperament, and his cultivation is even more unfathomable.
"It's not even comparable. It's a shame that I claim to be the youngest genius in the Three Thousand Worlds. Compared with me, I'm like an ant fighting against the sky. I can't compete at all."
Cai'er sighed to herself
"This brat is my son?"
Ling Zhentian looked at Ling Hao who walked into the palace and thought to himself, it didn't seem like this when they met a while ago. It's only been half a month since they last met. Why does it feel like he's a different person?
"Met father"
Ling Hao walked to the center of the palace and didn't even look at the people from Qingxiao Immortal Palace beside him. He bent down and said respectfully.
Ling Hao's face was calm, with no trace of expression on his face, and even his words were terrifyingly calm.
"This boy is extraordinary. In front of hundreds of people, he feels like he is in a deserted land. His nature is even calmer, and there is no sign of any disturbance."
Qingshuang on the side looked at Ling Hao and secretly said, she was even more amazed by Ling Hao.
"This marriage must be won, otherwise our Qingxiao Immortal Palace may not have a chance."
subsequently
"Okay, okay, Hao'er, please go back to your seat first. We will discuss the business later."
Ling Zhentian looked at Ling Hao with a smile and said with satisfaction, feeling even more proud of his son.
"Yes, father"
After saying that, Ling Hao returned to his exclusive position without even looking at Qingxiao Immortal Palace, as if it didn't exist at all.
"Master, why do I feel that Ling Shenzi doesn't want to see our Qingxiao Immortal Palace at all?"
Cai'er sent a message to Qingshuang in her heart and said, from Ling Haoru Palace to now, she has never seen Qingxiao Immortal Palace directly.
